versions.changelog:
Initial release of dark-fantasy-art-generator:

- Generates dark fantasy, grimdark, and gothic horror artwork via the Neta AI API.
- Supports custom prompts and reference image style inheritance.
- Offers flexible image sizing: portrait, landscape, square, tall.
- Designed for creative uses: D&D, album covers, game and novel concepts, horror art, and more.
- Requires a free Neta API token for use.
